'''Glossaries''' is a section of [[The Library of Ashurbanipal]] — plain-language dictionaries that define the terms you meet across the [[SoapBox]] ecosystem and the subjects the Library covers. Each glossary is a single, searchable page; new ones are added as the Library grows.

The idea is simple: '''you should never have to already know the words to start learning.''' A glossary lets a newcomer look up any term on the spot and follow it to a fuller article.

== Glossaries in the Library ==

* '''[[Crypto Glossary]]''' — blockchain and DeFi terms: block, wallet, fork, mining, ERC-20 / PRC-20, DEX, CDP, staking, and the rest. Start here to read anything else about the chains.
* '''[[Psychedelic and Psychopharmacology Glossary]]''' — plant-medicine and harm-reduction terms: agonist, dose-response, set and setting, reagent testing, the Shulgin Rating Scale, and more. Companion to [[PIHKAL and TIHKAL]].

''(More glossaries are being added — language/vocabulary, legal, and subject glossaries for the Library's other sections. This page is the index for all of them.)''

== How to use a glossary ==

* '''Look it up''' — glossaries are alphabetical; use the search box at the top of the Library to jump straight to a term.
* '''Follow the links''' — a defined term that has its own article is linked; click through when you want the depth.
* '''Contribute''' — spotted a missing or unclear term? Glossaries are living pages; adding good definitions is a way to contribute to the Library.

See also: [[The Library of Ashurbanipal]] · [[Crypto Glossary]] · [[SoapBox]] · [https://witness.melek.salon Witness School]
